summary.en: Joseph Kabila, former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, has joined the M23 rebels and is now leading a broader political-military front that includes additional anti-government forces. The coalition’s formation expands the rebel alliance beyond M23 alone and is fighting the Congolese army in North Kivu. Security personnel linked to Erik Prince were ambushed, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and wounds to former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. The conflict remains deadly, with 1,158 battle-related deaths recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Joseph Kabila, tidligere president i Den demokratiske republikken Kongo, har sluttet seg til M23-opprørerne og leder nå en bredere politisk-militær front som inkluderer flere anti-regjeringsstyrker. Koalisjonens dannelse utvider opprørsalliansen utover kun M23, og den kjemper mot den kongolesiske hæren i Nord-Kivu. Sikkerhetspersonell knyttet til Erik Prince ble overfalt, noe som førte til at en tidligere nyzealandsk spesialstyrkeoffiser ble drept og den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy ble såret. Konflikten forblir dødelig, med 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
